sn51.14:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde || || 2.
sn51.14:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū heṭṭhā Migāramātupāsāde viharanti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā || || 3.
sn51.14:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Mahā-Moggalānam āmantesi || ||
sn51.14:2.2: Ete kho Moggalāna sabrahmacāriyā heṭṭhā Migāramātupāsāde viharanti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā ||
sn51.14:3.1: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno Bhagavato paṭissutvā tathārūpam iddhābhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkhāresi || yathā pādaṅguṭṭhakena Migāramātupāsādam saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampacālesi || || 4.
sn51.14:3.2: Atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu ||
sn51.14:3.3: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn51.14:3.4: nivātañca vata ayaṃ ca Migaramatupāsādo gambhiranamo sunikhāto acalo asampakampi || atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālitoti || || 5.
sn51.14:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn51.14:4.2: Kiṃ nu tumhe bhikkhave saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekam antaṃ ṭhitā ti || ||
sn51.14:4.4: nivātañca vata ayaṃ ca Migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampi || atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito ti || || 6.
sn51.14:4.5: Tumheva kho bhikkhave saṃvejetukāmena Moggalānena bhikkhunā pādaṅguṭṭhakena Migāramātupāsādo saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito || ||
sn51.14:4.7: katamesaṃ dhammānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Moggalāno bhikkhu evam mahiddhiko evam mahānubhāvo ti || ||
sn51.14:4.8: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavaṃnettikā-Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī ti || || 7.
sn51.14:5.2: Catunnaṃ kho bhikkhave iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Moggalāno bhikkhu evam mahiddhiko evam mahānubhāvo ||
sn51.14:5.4: Idha bhikkhave Moggalano bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.14:5.8: Iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati na ca atipaggahītā bhavissati ||
sn51.14:5.9: na ca ajjhattaṃsaṅkhittā bhavissati || na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati ||
sn51.14:5.11: yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure ||
sn51.14:5.12: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho ||
sn51.14:5.13: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā || ||
sn51.14:5.14: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittam bhāveti || || 9.
sn51.14:5.15: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Moggalāno bhikkhu evam mahiddhiko evam mahānubhāvo || || 10. Imesaṃ
sn51.14:5.16: ca pana bhikkhave catunnam iddhipādānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā Moggalāno bhikkhu anekavihitam iddhividham paccanubhoti || la-pe || yāva brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti || || 11. imesaṃ
sn51.14:5.17: ca pana bhikkhave catunnam iddhipadānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā Moggalāno bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim ||pe || upasampajja viharatīti || || 12.
